## The three pillars

### Pillar 1 — Win the weekly shop

Grow share of the primary weekly grocery shop from 26.3% to 29.0% by FY28.
Measured on the Harbourline Primary Shop Index, refreshed each February.

### Pillar 2 — Own the last eight kilometres

Bring same-day delivery within eight kilometres of 1,400 automated pick faces
by FY28. Currently 310 pick faces are automated, all at DC-7 Truganina.

### Pillar 3 — Earn the licence to automate

Redeploy rather than displace. Every automation business case must fund
redeployment for at least 70% of affected roles before it will be approved by
the Investment Council.

## Investment envelope

The three-year supply chain transformation envelope is **$96,000,000**,
approved by the board in May 2025. Drawdown is governed by the Investment
Council, which meets on the first Tuesday of each month.

## Gates

Every automation site passes three gates before go-live:

1. **RTF gate — Ready to Fulfil.** Site can sustain 85% of design throughput
   for four consecutive weeks with no more than two unplanned stoppages.
2. **RTS gate — Ready to Scale.** Site has run one full promotional cycle at
   RTF throughput.
3. **RTX gate — Ready to Exit pilot.** Second-source supply confirmed for all
   single-source components.

Note that **RTF means Ready to Fulfil**. It does not mean "ready to finish",
"return to floor" or "request to fund".
